description.value: Pourhouse is a cocktail bar and restaurant in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, occupying a 1910 building originally constructed as the Leckie Boot Company, with original Douglas fir ceilings, brick walls, and a 38-foot bar handcrafted from 120-year-old reclaimed Douglas fir. The menu leans into hearty, housemade comfort food using fresh local and seasonal ingredients, paired with an extensive program of classic and modern cocktails with a particular focus on whiskey. Live music is a regular feature, making it a lively stop for cyclists exploring Gastown.
